scientific_decision: Use validation aligned to geographic transfer and dependence
paper_implementation: Reviewed cross-validation strategies for structured data and recommended blocking when observations are dependent
repository_implementation: Freeze geographic transferability as later estimand and exclude random pixel CV

scientific_decision: Characterize autocorrelation before model fitting with raw target variograms

repository_implementation: Sample 5000 locations per target support and estimate isotropic raw-response variograms
adaptation: Three support-specific samples; strict FLPs share locations

scientific_decision: Keep range measurement separate from fold geometry
paper_implementation: Measured response spatial autocorrelation with an empirical semivariogram then built spatial validation units slightly larger than that range
repository_implementation: Measure target dependence only
adaptation: No clustering or spatial unit scale selected

scientific_decision: Use Matheron empirical semivariance and effective range from Python implementation
paper_implementation: Presented SciKit-GStat empirical estimators theoretical fits and effective-range parameterization

scientific_decision: Select theoretical family by weighted residual sum of squares

repository_implementation: Fit spherical exponential Gaussian and Matérn with free nugget and select minimum N/h² weighted SSE

scientific_decision: Use separate spatial tuning and assessment loops later

repository_implementation: Record later need for separate spatial loops
adaptation: No nested CV implemented in 5A

scientific_decision: Do not interpret spatial CV as design-unbiased fixed-map accuracy
paper_implementation: Distinguished spatial cross-validation from design-based map accuracy assessment
repository_implementation: Constrain future interpretation to geographic transferability
adaptation: No model performance estimate in 5A

scientific_decision: Map canonical target names to analysis aliases
paper_implementation: Stored physical target columns as BP and FLP1 through FLP6
repository_implementation: Read physical columns and expose lowercase bp and flp1 through flp6 in analysis outputs
adaptation: User approved read-time aliases; no canonical modification or value conversion

scientific_decision: Use automap nonuniform sample-bounding-box lag boundaries
citation: Valavi et al. (2019) and automap autofitVariogram source
paper_implementation: Automap scales twelve uneven lag boundaries to 35 percent of projected input bounding-box diagonal
repository_implementation: Derive the same twelve boundaries separately from each frozen 5000-cell sample
adaptation: Run 1 full-extent equal-width bins are superseded

scientific_decision: Merge undersupported short-distance bins
paper_implementation: Default merge.small.bins is true with min.np.bin equal to five and earliest boundary removed until retained bins meet threshold
repository_implementation: Use five-pair minimum and recompute empirical bins after dropping first boundary
adaptation: No observation creation or semivariance interpolation

scientific_decision: Use distance-sensitive weighted fitting
citation: Hiemstra et al. (2009) and automap/gstat fitting procedure
paper_implementation: Automatic theoretical fits use distance-sensitive residual criterion and select lowest fitted SSE
repository_implementation: Set SciKit fitting sigma proportional to mean lag distance divided by square root of pair count; select minimum N/h squared weighted SSE
adaptation: SciKit fits at upper lag boundaries while automap uses empirical mean distances

scientific_decision: Report effective range only with supported sill
paper_implementation: SciKit-GStat parameterizes models by effective range and supports nugget plus partial sill
repository_implementation: Report nugget partial sill total sill ratio and conservative resolved-range diagnostic
adaptation: The empirical support and tail-fit checks are repository diagnostics not a source-defined threshold

scientific_decision: Keep first run as superseded provenance
paper_implementation: HITL rejected full-extent first-bin resolution and stable-for-Stein interpretation
repository_implementation: Archive Run 1 diagnostics and use Run 2 for range inference
adaptation: Three sampled Parquet inputs remain byte-identical

scientific_decision: Freeze accepted target-specific Run 2 range findings
paper_implementation: Not a literature claim; Run 2 fits and empirical lag support are retained in the report tables
repository_implementation: Accept BP 211.151 km FLP2 173.810 km and unconditional FLEP8 82.059 km with weaker unweighted fit; six other targets remain RANGE_UNRESOLVED
adaptation: No universal target-derived range follows from the multi-output results

scientific_decision: Do not treat variogram nugget as model aleatoric uncertainty
paper_implementation: Reports the nugget as a component of the spatial variogram model
repository_implementation: Report raw-target nugget within each selected variogram fit
adaptation: No fitted predictive model or aleatoric decomposition exists in 5A

scientific_decision: Determine spatial quantity governing validation separation
citation: Roberts et al. (2017) and Ploton et al. (2020)
paper_implementation: Discuss dependence-aware validation and give a response-range-based mapping example
repository_implementation: Defer whether BP predictors residuals or another literature-backed quantity governs scale
adaptation: Target-specific ranges do not imply a universal multi-output validation separation

scientific_decision: Choose block cluster or buffered validation geometry
citation: Roberts et al. (2017) and Ploton et al. (2020)
paper_implementation: Discuss structured resampling and give one clustered large-scale mapping example
repository_implementation: No validation geometry or buffer distance chosen

scientific_decision: Choose outer fold count and fold allocation
paper_implementation: Reviewed spatially structured cross-validation designs and their prediction-task dependence
repository_implementation: No outer folds or allocation selected

scientific_decision: Specify inner spatial resampling for tuning
paper_implementation: Compared nested spatial cross-validation for tuning and final performance estimation
repository_implementation: No inner fold count allocation or tuning loop selected
adaptation: Implementation remains a later HITL decision

scientific_decision: Choose any final train validation test proportions
paper_implementation: Related validation structure to intended prediction task and dependence
repository_implementation: No proportions or split selected

scientific_decision: Use spatial k-fold dead zone with strict exclusion
journal: International Journal of Geographical Information Science
paper_implementation: Spatial k-fold CV removes observations within a specified dead-zone radius of held-out observations
repository_implementation: Define TEST DEAD_ZONE TRAIN for each fold; TRAIN distance strictly exceeds radius
adaptation: Full native-grid Euclidean transform replaces point-wise pair searches

scientific_decision: Set exclusion scale from accepted BP response range
paper_implementation: Used response autocorrelation range to inform spatial validation separation
repository_implementation: Read exact accepted Checkpoint 5A BP effective range as radius
adaptation: Use primary BP response with complete support; Valavi et al. (2019) provides supporting autocorrelation workflow

scientific_decision: Support response autocorrelation scale
paper_implementation: blockCV workflow estimates spatial autocorrelation to guide spatial resampling
repository_implementation: Use accepted 5A raw BP variogram result
adaptation: Supporting source only; no new range estimation

scientific_decision: Create coordinate k-means outer folds
paper_implementation: Used k-means spatial partitioning for performance assessment
repository_implementation: Five centroids fit only on x_5070 and y_5070; every row assigned nearest centroid
adaptation: Exact uniform-without-replacement row-position sample of 1097262 cells followed by MiniBatchKMeans; pre-HITL modulo-101 stripe sample superseded

scientific_decision: Use five outer folds
paper_implementation: Used five-fold outer performance estimation with repeated runs and nested tuning
repository_implementation: Freeze one five-fold outer partition with one test membership per canonical row
adaptation: No repeats or inner tuning folds in this checkpoint

scientific_decision: Occurrence plus conditional severity factorization
paper_implementation: Estimated fire occurrence conditional large-fire given ignition and unconditional large-fire probability
repository_implementation: Shared representation with BP and conditional six-class FLP heads; derived FLEP8
adaptation: FSim BP and six flame-length classes replace observed ignition/large-fire outcomes

scientific_decision: Sigmoid BP and normalized six-way softmax FLP
paper_implementation: Implemented shared multitask network with sigmoid binary output and softmax multiclass output
repository_implementation: One BP logit and six FLP logits; preserve soft canonical targets and strict mask
adaptation: Here sigmoid encodes BP and six-way softmax encodes conditional FSim FLP; original tasks were surgical image tasks

scientific_decision: Soft logarithmic-score losses for supplied probability targets
journal: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper_implementation: Established strict propriety of logarithmic score for probability distributions
repository_implementation: Soft Bernoulli cross-entropy on BP and soft categorical cross-entropy on six FLPs
adaptation: Expected-score application to supplied simulator probabilities; no observed binary labels

scientific_decision: Unweighted FLP loss on strict conditional support
paper_implementation: Separated occurrence and conditional large-fire probability
repository_implementation: Train FLP only where flp_target_valid; do not multiply FLP loss by BP
adaptation: Exact mask and no-BP-weighting rule follow mathematically from conditional estimand; paper did not implement these losses

scientific_decision: Shared multi-output MLP with task-specific heads
paper_implementation: Modeled multitask neural networks with shared hidden representation and task-specific output weights
repository_implementation: Shared feed-forward MLP with BP and FLP output heads
adaptation: No architecture novelty; final depth and width are HPO dimensions

scientific_decision: Use fixed equal weights on separately averaged BP and FLP task losses as a transparent multitask baseline
paper_implementation: Implemented Equal Weights as a multitask neural-network baseline alongside adaptive alternatives; task balancing was studied as a substantive optimization problem
repository_implementation: HITL-approved L_tune=0.5 mean BP loss + 0.5 mean FLP loss on separate valid supports; criterion fixed across all HPO trials
adaptation: No claim of optimal BP/FLP weighting; task-weight optimization is outside the study scope and weights are not hyperparameters

scientific_decision: Fixed log1p on four nonnegative density predictors
citation: Joseph et al. (2019); Sze et al. (2019)
paper_implementation: Used log housing density in US wildfire modeling; log-transformed population density in fire-count analysis
repository_implementation: log1p HUDEN2020 POPDEN2020 OCCHUDEN2020 VACHUDEN2020 before scaling
adaptation: Zero-preserving log1p and all four SILVIS fields are project adaptations

scientific_decision: Training-partition mean imputation with missingness information
paper_implementation: Analyzed constant imputation for supervised prediction and missingness indicators; applied training-set imputation values to test
repository_implementation: Impute missing numeric inputs with current-training means; retain six valid-area fractions plus WUI coverage and binary failure among exactly 33 model inputs
adaptation: The 6B HITL representation excludes source-null diagnostics because canonical coverage and valid-area/category shares recover them up to tolerance; nullable selected shares/coverage use the same training-only imputation

scientific_decision: Fit all learned preprocessing only on training partition
citation: Moscovich and Rosset (2022); Josse et al. (2024)
journal: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B; Statistical Papers
paper_implementation: Showed pre-CV unsupervised feature rescaling can bias model selection; used training-set imputation values for test prediction
repository_implementation: Fit imputation and z-scaling on INNER TRAIN or complete OUTER TRAIN only
adaptation: Z-standardization and zero-variance safeguard are project engineering details

scientific_decision: Five coordinate-only inner spatial folds within each outer train
paper_implementation: Implemented spatial tuning and spatial assessment and recommended spatial partitioning for tuning
repository_implementation: Five deterministic coordinate-only inner folds; no recursive 211.151 km dead zone
adaptation: Exact inner count and absence of inner dead zone are project-specific choices

scientific_decision: TPE sequential hyperparameter sampler
paper_implementation: Used TPE to tune Earth-system surrogate neural-network architecture and learning rate
repository_implementation: Optuna TPESampler seeded 42
adaptation: Optuna package and seed are engineering choices

scientific_decision: ASHA-style resource-aware early pruning
paper_implementation: Compared ASHA and Bayesian HPO for temperature prediction; candidate algorithms included ANN
repository_implementation: Optuna SuccessiveHalvingPruner allocates epoch resources
adaptation: Paper used MATLAB and did not implement our Optuna TPE plus ASHA integration; final selected models were not ANN

scientific_decision: Prune only after five-fold mean at each resource milestone
citation: Schratz et al. (2019); Roy et al. (2024)
paper_implementation: Separately implemented spatial HPO and ASHA temperature HPO
repository_implementation: J_e is mean of five fold validation L_tune values before Optuna pruning

scientific_decision: W&B for experiment records only
paper_implementation: No scientific paper claim
repository_implementation: Log trials folds losses resources runtime utilization and provenance; no sweep selection
adaptation: Engineering-only choice

scientific_decision: Constrained MLP HPO family with AdamW weight decay
citation: Lu and Ricciuto (2019); Laloyaux et al. (2022)
journal: Geoscientific Model Development; Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
paper_implementation: Tuned NN depth width learning rate with TPE; used AdamW and tuned weight decay in NWP-bias neural network
repository_implementation: Depth 2/3 width 64/128/256 learning rate 1e-4..1e-2 weight decay 1e-5..1e-2; ReLU AdamW dropout 0

scientific_decision: Defer compute-budget quantities to throughput checkpoint
paper_implementation: No scientific paper claim
repository_implementation: Deferred batch size epoch budget trial count ASHA max resource execution location and workers at 6A; resolved by the approved 6B compute plan
adaptation: Freeze budget after 6B throughput benchmark and before HPO outcomes

scientific_decision: Prospective local HPO execution budget and five-study accounting
citation: Checkpoint 6B throughput benchmark and HITL direction
paper_implementation: Measured real TRAIN throughput on the local RTX 5080; no scientific literature claim
repository_implementation: Freeze BF16; batch sizes 32768/65536/131072; 100-epoch cap; ASHA 1/4/16/64 comparisons; 30 trials per each of five independent outer studies; one sequential local worker
